172:t_103:9.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I am $$ハマーン・カーン$$! Even without the $$赤い彗星$$, I will shoulder the Spacenoids' karma myself!」

172:t_104:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're relentless, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$! Do you mean to barge into other people's hearts uninvited again!?」

172:t_104:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I don't intend to keep dealing with a hardhead forever, either!」

172:t_104:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The same goes for Colonel $$シャア$$!」

172:t_104:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That tone of yours is exactly the insolence I'm talking about! Know your place, $$カミーユ$$!」

172:t_105:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You must be delighted, $$アムロ・レイ$$! To have pulled $$シャア$$ away from $$ジオン$$!」

172:t_105:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$ made that decision himself. I had nothing to do with it.」

172:t_105:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Nonsense! Your very existence led that man astray!」

172:t_105:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You will pay for that, $$アムロ$$! I will strike you down myself!」

172:t_105:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You're like a girl obsessed with purity, $$ハマーン$$! And they call you the Iron Lady? Don't make me laugh!」

172:t_106:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「How pitiful, boy! Did you part ways with the friend you trusted!?」

172:t_106:1.en:
$$シン$$
「Don't go pitying people on your own! I haven't despaired of anything!」

172:t_106:2.en:
$$シン$$
「I'm not like you! When I believe in someone, I believe in them to the very end, and I say everything I have to say!」

172:t_106:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Just what I'd expect from a friend of $$カミーユ・ビダン$$! You know nothing of manners!」

172:t_106:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You will pay for the words you spat out!」

172:t_106:5.en:
$$シン$$
「I won't lose to a woman who throws a hysterical fit when someone hits the truth!」

172:t_107:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Are you people going to drag $$プラント$$ into a war again!?」

172:t_107:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「They are the ones who chose it. We are merely cooperating with that choice.」

172:t_107:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「You people... twist people's feelings and misuse your power...!」

172:t_107:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It is the world that is twisted and wrong! I am fighting to change that, too!」

172:t_107:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「Then I will stop you! With the feelings $$ラクス$$ entrusted to me, and the power I hold!」

172:t_108:2.en:
$$クェス$$
「You're on the same level as that brat! When it comes to the Colonel!」

172:t_108:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That man betrayed $$ネオ・ジオン$$ even though he was its leader...! He must pay for that!」

172:t_108:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「That's not it, $$ハマーン$$! The Colonel is fighting for something much bigger!」

172:t_108:5.en:
$$クェス$$
「You of all people should be able to see that! Be honest and trust what you feel!」

172:t_109:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, we meet again, Reactor.」

172:t_109:1.en:
$n
「That suits me fine. All the more reason to pay back what I owe you from last time.」

172:t_109:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Now, now, there's no need for such dangerous talk. How about it? The boss's scouting offer from before... why not accept it?」

172:t_109:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As for your answer, please make it 'Yes' or 'Yes'.」

172:t_109:4.en:
$n
「Then I'll burn you to ashes! All of you!」

172:t_109:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well said! You've got me with that one!」

172:t_110:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It's been a while, $$セツコ$$. I'm glad to see you looking well.」

172:t_110:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... Of course. That's only natural. A perfectly understandable reaction.」

172:t_110:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$サルディアス$$...! I will stop you... and $$バルビエル$$ too, with these hands!」

172:t_110:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I won't let you spread your hatred across this world!」

172:t_110:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(As sharp as ever... No wonder the boss is wary of her...)
